text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired PD12345 — HIGH — routing latency/5xx spike in us-west-2 for service runtime-proxy. Trigger: 5xx_rate > 2% (30s window)

maria: I'm on it. starting root-cause sweep — checking recent deploys + autoscaler behavior.

sanjay: ack. any visible customer impact yet?

maria: quick look at traces: elevated 503s from proxy hosts behind dedicated pool, p95 up to ~810ms. frontends not returning 5xx broadly. suspect canary.

lucy: saw a small canary rollout to proxy-v2 ~3m ago (tag: proxy-v2-canary). holding rollback now.

maria: rollback executed to proxy-v1.2.4 at +60s from page. seeing error rate drop in tail — PD may auto-resolve soon.

incident-bot: PD12345 acknowledged by maria

sanjay: nice. can we confirm customer impact = none? do we need to notify support or customers?

maria: current sanity check: no spike in user-facing 5xx across stable routes, SLOs not breached. recommend no external notif, internal postmortem note only.

lucy: attaching immediate metrics snapshot:
```
503_rate: 2.8% -> 0.2%
p95_latency_ms: 810 -> 190
proxy_cpu_util: 72% -> 45%
active_canaries: 1 -> 0
```

sanjay: :thumbsup: suggest muting PD for 10m to avoid flapping while autoscaler and caches settle.

maria: muted PD for 10m. filing follow-up ticket INC-2026 with rollback details and correlation to canary. leaving short mitigation runbook.

lucy: ack — i'll monitor metrics for the next 15m and escalate if error rate rises again.

maria: thanks — closing this thread. PD auto-resolved at 6280001123. Notes saved to /ops/incidents/INC-2026.

sanjay: thanks all :pray:
